question: Does a second fixed model, DeepSeek Flash without thinking, improve the same development human-choice forecasts, with and without training human statistics?
documented_version: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, official pricing page accessed 2026-10-14; API alias is provider-managed, not a pinned local digest
budget_enforcement: Reserve each request using UTF-8 message byte count plus 512 template tokens and the full 32 output-token cap, at peak cache-miss rates. Reserve the full amount for requests with unknown usage; stop on missing usage or overruns. Hard cap covers only this script, not other account users; invoiced cost may differ from documented estimates.
no_retry: At most one attempt per frozen task, including failed requests; no parsing repair, no model substitution, no prompt adjustment or model-wide score selection.
prompt_policy: Copy each original frozen local task's exact system/user messages; replace provider-specific generation controls only. Use the same request order, family exclusion and human summaries. API has no frozen local model digest and no guaranteed seed match.
continuation_gate: Use the local experiment's numerical gate for DeepSeek human-context versus the three clean statistical references and its own scene-only ablation. Results remain development-only even on pass.
analysis: Complete valid set only; same condition-macro NLL/Brier, participant accuracy, per-family comparisons and no-map/equal-map/busy/free subgroups. One probability per condition per arm.
timing_disclosure: New model selected after local results and on user authorization; not part of the earlier 4B pre-inference comparison. Any result is a separate development extension, not independent confirmation.
privacy: Send only the public virtual-task scene summaries and training condition counts. Credential stored in Windows-user DPAPI file ignored by Git; credential and authorization headers never stored in experiment artifacts.
